raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The CUDA `diffusion` extra in `python/pyproject.toml` lists `websockets`. `diffusion_common` in `python/pyproject_other.toml` does not. That block is the base for `diffusion_hip` (installed by the ROCm Docker image and, through `all_hip`, by the AMD CI), and for `diffusion_musa` and `diffusion_mps`.

Without `websockets` or `wsproto`, uvicorn cannot accept a WebSocket upgrade, so the realtime video API is unreachable on ROCm installs:

- **The shipped image.** `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.21-rocm10-mi35x-20261014` (SGLang `bab9c81`) has neither package. On it, a `robbyant/lingbot-world-fast-diffusers` server with `--pipeline-class-name LingBotWorldCausalDMDPipeline` reports healthy on 1× MI355X, but an upgrade request to `/v1/realtime_video/generate` gets `404 Not Found`, and uvicorn logs `No supported WebSocket library detected. Please use "pip install 'uvicorn[standard]'", or install 'websockets' or 'wsproto' manually.`
- **The AMD CI.** It hits the same gap from the client side. `lingbot_world_realtime_plastic_beach` is skipped on every `multimodal-gen-test-1-gpu-amd` run (for example scheduled run 38661136204, partition 3) at the `websockets` import guard in `test/server/realtime_consistency.py`, so the realtime path never runs on AMD.

## Modifications

Add `websockets` to `diffusion_common`, unpinned as in the CUDA extra.

## Accuracy Tests

Same image and server on 1× MI355X (gfx950), with `websockets` 17.2 installed:

- The upgrade request returns `101 Switching Protocols`.
- `pytest sglang/multimodal_gen/test/server/test_server_1_gpu.py -k lingbot_world_realtime_plastic_beach` gives 1 passed in 95.7 s.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No kernel or model change. Chunk timings from that run (832×480, warmup off):

- The first chunk takes 27.4 s, which includes the first-call compile.
- The next three take 1.75–1.89 s per 12-frame chunk.

cc @HaiShaw @michaelzhang-ai, since this also lets the AMD lane run the realtime LingBot-World case instead of skipping it.

<!-- pr-states:start -->
---
### CI States

Latest PR Test (Base): <!-- slot:pr-test:start -->:x: [Run #41658858120](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41658858120)<!-- slot:pr-test:end -->
Latest PR Test (Extra): <!-- slot:pr-test-extra:start -->:x: [Run #41658857850](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41658857850)<!-- slot:pr-test-extra:end -->
Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): <!-- slot:pr-test-amd:start -->:x: [Run #41658857577](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41658857577)<!-- slot:pr-test-amd:end -->

> ```
<!-- pr-states:end -->

nodes.body: @michaelzhang-ai thanks for the reply on #44421. Could you add `run-ci` here when you get a chance? The AMD 1-GPU diffusion lane is the one that matters for this change. With `websockets` installed, `lingbot_world_realtime_plastic_beach` should run there instead of being skipped. With the same dependency added it passed on an MI355X (1 passed, 95.7 s).

Thanks, the diff looks right: `diffusion_common` was the only diffusion extra missing `websockets` compared to the CUDA extra, and the AMD diffusion jobs install it through `dev_hip`. Added `run-ci`. One small thing: the commit also flips `pyproject_other.toml` from 755 to 644. Could you restore the mode so the diff is just the one line? I'll check partition 3 of `multimodal-gen-test-1-gpu-amd`, since that lane runs on MI300 rather than MI355X.

@michaelzhang-ai Restored the 755 mode in 6d1c0ce, so the diff is now only the one-line `websockets` addition.

From the earlier `run-ci` run: `lingbot_world_realtime_plastic_beach` now runs on the AMD 1-GPU lane instead of being skipped, and it passes on `multimodal-gen-test-1-gpu-amd` shard 3 (MI300). The failures in that run look unrelated to this change:

- shard 0: `test_residual_gate_add2` bit-identity check, plus the two `test_perf_fixture_retains_failed_case_results` cases
- shard 1: `test_kandinsky6_bf16_dtype` FA dispatch, `test_rowwise_fp8` subtests
- shard 2: collection error in `test_flux3_prims_ts_config.py` (`No module named 'flashinfer'`)
- shard 3: `test_kandinsky6_layerwise_offload` (audio-vae), `test_qwen3_5_encoder[fa]`

@michaelzhang-ai One more AMD diffusion gap we noticed while reading the AMD lane: `pr-test-amd.yml` runs the multimodal-gen suites with `SGLANG_SKIP_CONSISTENCY=1`, and both `get_consistency_platform()` and `get_perf_baseline_platform()` fall back to the H100 files on ROCm. So an AMD-only numerical regression (for example a wrong attention backend) would still pass. Intel added `intel_xpu_b60.json` thresholds for the same situation. Would an AMD thresholds file be useful to you, so consistency can be switched on for the AMD lane? If yes, would you prefer that we measure the cases on MI355X, or could one lane run with `SGLANG_SKIP_CONSISTENCY=0` so the thresholds come from the MI300 runners themselves?
